name: solodev-studio
description: SoloDev Studio — launches Django (8001) + Frontend (3000/5174) together

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "python server/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8001" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:vite: concurrently --names "backend,vite" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "python server/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8001" "npm --prefix frontend exec vite -- --port 5174 --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort"
scripts.install:all: pip install -r server/requirements.txt && npm install --prefix frontend
